questions.title: Eq Override Field Comparison
questions.description: Ticket overrides __eq__ to compare row and seat. What does the snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Ticket:
    def __init__(self, row, seat):
        self.row = row
        self.seat = seat

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.row == other.row and self.seat == other.seat

a = Ticket(3, "A")
b = Ticket(3, "A")
c = Ticket(4, "B")
print(a == b)
print(a == c)
